text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation), mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia, mild thrombocytopenia, monocytosis, basophilia, and mild hyperchloremia. Liver and kidney function, electrolytes, and glucose are within normal limits except for low ALT. Findings suggest possible bone marrow suppression or infiltration and impaired oxygenation; clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
